name: Squirmlet
look: a tiny chubby grey worm on stubby orange-toed legs, an orange back ring, an orange hood with big round eye discs, a blue face and a short cyan snout drooping like a hose
entry: It hides in damp leaf litter and only comes out after the rain. When it is startled, it squirts a thread of sticky goo from its little hose of a snout, then scurries away while its attacker struggles.
how: Wild: common in jungles, swamps and bamboo forests, and in forests while it rains.
Evolves into Nozzlurm at level 18, learning Water Pulse.
